ARABIC — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Phonological awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness.
